outlook.statement: Although, market conditions are likely to remain competitive, future success will depend upon offering improved products through technology innovation and productivity. The Company continues to invest in these areas.

The long-term outlook for the Indian real estate sector remains positive, supported by urbanisation, infrastructure development, rising household income and continuing demand for residential and commercial assets. The Company will continue to monitor market developments and evaluate opportunities aligned with its business objectives and available resources, and proposes to explore opportunities to develop new verticals within its existing lines of business, wherever considered commercially viable, with a view to diversifying its operations, strengthening its market presence and addressing evolving market and customer requirements.
